problems: WebFetch returns a summariser's text, not the page: the quotation marks in event notes reproduce what the summariser returned and may not be word-for-word the Wikipedia text; where a sentence was a paraphrase it is not in quotation marks.

Capital coordinates and some region circles are the usual site values, not from the pages; each such event note says so. Land for rebel and client states is a reading of Cliopatria shapes or of gazetteer regions where the pages give no boundary.
Seven pages failed to load (pages_failed); five candidate states were dropped because their pages were too thin.

18 dossiers are written against a brief that asks for 6-10 plus any state of 10+ years with an article. Five run under ten years (kingdom-of-herod-agrippa-i 7, revolt-of-timarchus 3, bessus-artaxerxes-v 1, harsiesi 1, cleopatra-ii-alexandria 4 by their year spans) because they are the slugs other dossiers already name as counterparts or successors.

Several dossiers rest on a single Wikipedia page (emesa, cyrene-under-ptolemy-viii, bessus, cleopatra-ii, tarcondimotid, harsiesi, yehud): their dated sentences are as the summariser returned them and one page cannot cross-check them.
